label: Richter always saved
summary: Defeating Richter always takes the 'Richter saved' route (the Shaft's-orb cutscene that opens the Inverted Castle) instead of his normal defeat.

edits.why: Redirect lethal damage to the saved pose; reuse the skipped death block to combine Richter and orb death flags.
Orb death check calls the helper, then resumes its normal signal reset and death sequence.

vanilla.reason: The guarded Richter and orb code is identical in vanilla US and the current ASS image.

overlaps.detail: 0xB0 bytes before its word at 0x3548C; no overlap.

notes: Fix for the old sitting-only patch: the orb now sees lethal Richter damage and runs its native step 20, emits D_us_801D169C once, creates factories 0x49 and 0x4B, and destroys itself in step 21. The native signal sends both stock and Epic Richter thinking to step 0x28. No early castle-unlock write. The helper occupies only the normal death block skipped by this hack, and removal restores it. onVersions recognizes only the complete old broken jump with unchanged helper and orb hook. Keep WIP/off in the shipped release until fresh-boot gameplay confirms dialogue and Inverted Castle access.
